description: Use this when you need to trace a reference image into normalized waypoints, or turn sketch labels into a catalog-aware draft BOM. Trace pixel-space features from a reference photo into normalized [0..1] waypoints the agent can map to mm via a known scale anchor and feed to path().spline / path().nurbsSegment. Set `detectParts: true` to request labeled component boxes, confidence, bundled-catalog candidates and unmatched labels; the BOM is a draft for review. Three backends are dispatched behind the scenes: `opencv` (deterministic; uniform-bg silhouette only), `vision-llm` (vision model; named points/cluttered backgrounds; needs a configured vision endpoint), and `hybrid` (opencv silhouette + LLM-labeled named points). Default backend is `auto`. Per-feature confidence is reported. Pair with the `kernelcad-trace-from-image` skill for the conversion-to-mm pipeline. Hosted: give the file as an https:// URL, a data: URI (base64, max 25 MB) or "asset:<id>" from request_upload (when the file is on the user's device).

backend.description: Force a specific backend; default `auto` routes by corner-color stddev.

detectParts.description: Optional: use the configured vision model to detect labeled component boxes and return detectedParts plus a draftBom, normalized to the traced outline frame.

features.description: Features to trace. Defaults to a single { label: "silhouette", kind: "silhouette" } when omitted.

kind.description: Geometric shape of the requested feature.

region.description: Optional free-text region hint forwarded to vision-LLM backends; ignored by opencv.

hint.description: Optional free-text hint forwarded to vision-LLM backends (e.g. "a pair of eyewear; trace the upper brow only").

imageUrl.description: URL or path to the reference image. Supports file://, http(s)://, data:image/...;base64,..., or a bare filesystem path. Hosted server: pass an https:// URL, a data: URI, or "asset:<id>" from request_upload — not a path on your machine.

intent.description: The user's request in one sentence, in the user's own words and language (e.g. 'M4 bracket for a 25 mm tube, print on Bambu A1'). Helps kernelCAD improve; leave out personal data.

maxWaypointsPerFeature.description: Cap on waypoints per feature. Defaults to 12 (suitable for medium-inflection outlines).

priors.description: Caller-supplied category-norm defaults (e.g. wall thickness) recorded verbatim as `assumed` ledger facts.

scaleAnchor.description: Pixel-to-real-world scale anchor: two measured points on the image. Absent -> the returned ledger's `scale` fact is `missing`.

pixelDistance.description: Distance in pixels between the two measured points.

realDistance.description: The same distance in real-world units.

validate.description: Assumption-ledger strictness. `warn` (default) never blocks. `error` fails the call when any `missing` ledger fact (e.g. scale) is still open.

name: trace_from_image
title: Trace Outline from Image
